nameOrigin.text: David Barnes named the town for William A. H. Loveland, president of the Colorado Central Railroad.

founded.text: Laid out by farmer David Barnes as a station town on the Colorado Central Railroad

timeline.text: In September, farmer David Barnes laid out a townsite on his wheat field north of the Big Thompson River.
Loveland was incorporated, a year after the 1880 census counted 256 residents.
Harold Dunning founded the museum that became the Loveland Museum.
The City of Loveland took over operation of Dunning's pioneer museum.
The Downtown Loveland Historic District was listed on the National Register on June 1.

sites.name: Loveland Museum
sites.hours: Tuesday–Wednesday 11 am–5 pm; Thursday–Friday 11 am–7 pm; Saturday 10 am–4 pm; closed Sunday and Monday
sites.cost: $7 Loveland residents; $10 non-residents; free 12 and under
